verdict.rationale: Exa's docs say its MCP server is open source and on GitHub, and the exa-js SDK is hosted publicly on GitHub, so some first-party code is readable. Nothing in the evidence shows the core search engine, index, or API service is open-sourced, and no specific open license is named for any repo. missing for 10: open-source core search/index service, a named OSI license for the published repos, independent confirmation of licensing terms.
